title: Kestrel Lease Standing and the Pre-Owned Retail Settlement Percentage
content:
The settlement percentage on a deficiency under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract follows the customer's active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease. Where the customer holds more than one active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease, the first one the lease lookup lists is the one read.

| The active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease read | Relationship adjustment |
|---|---|
| No days past due and at least 12 lease payments made (the relationship minimum) | lowered by 5 points (the relationship points) |
| Any days past due | raised by 5 points (the delinquent-relationship points) |
| No days past due and fewer than 12 lease payments made | unchanged |
| No active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease | unchanged |

### Hypothetical leases

- Active lease, 0 days past due, 20 payments made: lowered by 5 points.
- Active lease, 0 days past due, 7 payments made: unchanged.
- Active lease, 12 days past due, 40 payments made: raised by 5 points — any days past due raise it, whatever the payment count.
- The customer's only Kestrel lease ended last year and none is active: unchanged.
